source_principles: Spine two-bone IK target must be independent of constrained descendants.
Constraint order is part of the rig design.
Live2D parent controls should not be polluted by unrelated child intent.
intent: Separate semantic controls that can move independently, especially hand, strap, gun, and face.
applies_when: one target currently controls multiple semantic parts
a contact action causes unrelated cloth or prop movement
a runtime patch is being used to hide shared constraint behavior
recommended_structure: control target bones are separate from deformation bones
hand uses a two-bone IK chain
strap uses an independent target or secondary chain
gun has an explicit grip or prop target
constraint order is recorded and tested
